decision_or_assumption: One county-year; 58 California counties and 67 Florida counties for 2010-2025.
reason: Matches requested geography and period.
modeling_consequence: Expected panel has 2,000 rows.

decision_or_assumption: Interpreted as candidate covariates grouped by substantive category, not fitted regression coefficients.
reason: No target or model has yet been selected.
modeling_consequence: Do not rank variables as effects until a target and validation plan exist.

decision_or_assumption: Published values are retained alongside a limited set of transparent arithmetic rates, annual averages, and policy codings documented in the dictionary.
reason: Keeps provenance while making the workbook graphable and immediately usable.
modeling_consequence: Further learned cleaning or imputation must occur in a separate derivative file.

decision_or_assumption: Missing, suppressed, and not-yet-published values remain blank; none are converted to zero.
reason: A blank is not evidence of no event.
modeling_consequence: Coverage must be checked before every chart/model.

decision_or_assumption: Rows exist for 2025 even when a lagged source ends in 2024.
reason: The user requested an inclusive 2010-2025 panel.
modeling_consequence: Restrict models to common coverage or use source-aware missingness methods.

decision_or_assumption: PEP population/housing use 2019 vintage through 2019 and 2025 vintage from 2020 onward.
reason: These are the official files spanning the requested period.
modeling_consequence: Do not treat the 2019-to-2020 difference as a pure annual change without sensitivity checks.

decision_or_assumption: SAIPE 90% confidence intervals are retained alongside point estimates.
reason: County estimates have uncertainty.
modeling_consequence: Use uncertainty in interpretation; avoid over-ranking small differences.

decision_or_assumption: Only M13 annual-average LAUS observations are compiled; monthly records remain in raw API JSON.
reason: Creates one value per county-year.
modeling_consequence: 2025 excludes October and needs a chart/model caution.

decision_or_assumption: Total authorized units/value are mechanical sums of the four published structure-size categories.
reason: The annual county file has components rather than one total column.
modeling_consequence: Treat reported-place coverage as a quality field.

decision_or_assumption: HPI is an index, not a dollar price; unavailable small-county values remain missing.
reason: Prevents false price interpretation.
modeling_consequence: Do not combine it directly with dollar outcomes without defining the transformation.

decision_or_assumption: BEA population is retained even though Census PEP population also exists.
reason: It documents the denominator underlying BEA per-capita income.
modeling_consequence: Choose one population definition per model and run a sensitivity check.

decision_or_assumption: No county homelessness outcome is inserted in this build.
reason: HUD PIT data are primarily Continuum-of-Care geography, not a consistent county-year measure.
modeling_consequence: A documented CoC-to-county allocation decision is required before county homelessness modeling.

decision_or_assumption: All variables are observational candidate predictors.
reason: The panel does not identify causal effects by itself.
modeling_consequence: Use time controls, county effects, lags, and time-based validation; avoid causal language.

decision_or_assumption: Same-year measures are not automatically safe predictors.
reason: Some economic releases are revised and outcomes may be contemporaneous.
modeling_consequence: Define the prediction date and lag predictors before predictive modeling.

decision_or_assumption: Raw totals and published rates are both retained; selected population-normalized rates are mechanical derivations.
reason: Totals preserve source data; rates improve comparability.
modeling_consequence: Keep the raw numerator and denominator in any model audit.

decision_or_assumption: BLS annual LAUS measures are retrieved in FRED batches of no more than 12 series and cover all counties and years.
reason: FRED silently truncates larger graph-CSV requests; the 12-series limit was verified and enforced.
modeling_consequence: The 2025 annual estimate remains an 11-month BLS average excluding October.

decision_or_assumption: Annual Zillow values are arithmetic means of the available monthly county values; month counts are retained.
reason: The source is monthly and the panel is annual.
modeling_consequence: Do not describe the annual sale-price value as a median over all transactions in the year.

decision_or_assumption: ZORI is retained as a typical observed market-rent index and is not renamed median rent.
reason: ZORI and ACS median gross rent have different concepts and coverage.
modeling_consequence: Do not combine or coalesce ZORI with ACS rent measures.

decision_or_assumption: Eviction Lab modeled counts, uncertainty bounds, and source flags are retained through 2018.
reason: The national county series is the only consistent source covering every county in the requested states before 2019.
modeling_consequence: Do not append post-2020 tracking data without a comparability study.

decision_or_assumption: 2024 Gazetteer land area is applied to every county-year.
reason: A single official land-area denominator permits a consistent density calculation.
modeling_consequence: Density changes reflect population changes, not boundary revisions.

decision_or_assumption: Population and housing growth are suppressed for 2010 and 2020.
reason: 2010 lacks a prior panel year; 2020 crosses the Census estimate-vintage boundary.
modeling_consequence: Do not fill the suppressed growth cells from adjacent years.

decision_or_assumption: Minimum wage and Medicaid expansion status are state-year measures repeated across counties.
reason: The requested concepts are state policies rather than county measures.
modeling_consequence: They contain no within-state cross-county variation and require state-clustered interpretation.

decision_or_assumption: California is coded expanded beginning in 2014 and Florida is coded not expanded through 2025.
reason: California implemented ACA expansion on 2014-01-01; Florida had not implemented it by the panel end.
modeling_consequence: The binary flag does not measure enrollment, generosity, or county implementation intensity.

decision_or_assumption: Conceptually different but relevant measures are included only under precise names: ZORI is not median rent, overall housing-cost burden is not renter-only burden, the quintile ratio is not Gini, and high-school attainment is not a graduation rate.
reason: Prevents definition drift while retaining useful predictors.
modeling_consequence: Use requested_variable_status.csv before selecting variables.

decision_or_assumption: The foreclosure-rate field is reserved and blank.
reason: No free comparable county-year foreclosure-rate series covering 2010-2025 was verified.
modeling_consequence: Do not substitute mortgage delinquency or foreclosure starts without renaming and documenting the new concept.
